scopeReview: CED FUN-6.A.1–3: exact geometric integrals, linearity, constant integrands, reversal, adjacent intervals and extension to bounded removable/jump discontinuities. Symmetry and order comparisons use direct signed-area pairing and nonnegative differences. No BC-only antiderivative technique is assessed; the semicircle is evaluated geometrically.
varietyReview: Oriented adjacent intervals, a linear combination including a constant width, an absolute-value triangle, a semicircle, odd plus constant, jump/isolated value, invalid product/square rules, actual accumulation table differences, non-strict integral ordering, even negative area and solving for positive/negative area magnitudes. Eight independent arithmetic/table computations complement three exact reasoning checks.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
